_about: Amou Nagiri (131158, psychic_katana): a formal swordswoman who likes four-character idioms (rendered as short English sayings). Name order follows units.json. Global names/terms: Soushiro, Yuki Mishima, Rinne Hikawa, Yae Asato, Seiji Takamori, Shota Inori, Mocha, Cocoa, Guild Knights, Provisional Guild Knight, Aegis, Special Tech Defense Force, Palpebra, the Farlands, Starview Village. Own: Amou Style (天羽流), Heavenly Thunder Flash (skill, as in units.json), Hizakura Girls' Academy (as in Yae's file), Thor (トール).
profile: Amou Nagiri. A 16-year-old first-year high school student. A sword prodigy named rightful heir of the Amou Style by her grandfather, a Living National Treasure. At first glance she seems a well-bred young lady with a class-president air, but the true essence of her blade flashes like lightning to pass judgment.
titleCondition: Level Amou Nagiri to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/kenzen: They say a sound mind dwells in a sound body. Won't you all join me in training?
speech.home/konoaida: The other day, I passed a blonde girl as pretty as a doll... and her sword presence was tremendous. I'd love to cross blades with her once...!
speech.home/onaji: Even among swordsmen, everyone's different. It's fascinating! For example, my sword is closer to the Farlands' knights than to adventurers or pirates. If I may say so, it's well-mannered.
speech.home/kokodakeno: Just between us, I truly respect Yae. ...If I'd had strength like hers, maybe I wouldn't have left that girl alone.
speech.home/shibuyano: There's a movement to reopen Shibuya's schools. Should I really go back? The Guild Knights are an option for employment, too, so it's a tough choice... Above all, a co-ed school would be a first for me...!
speech.home/kurepu: I rarely ate crêpes before unless Yae invited me. ...And yet, strangely, they make me feel nostalgic.
speech.ally/join: We finally meet! My name is Amou Nagiri. This body, this sword. Please use them as you see fit, including to help people in need.
speech.ally/evolution: In an ever-changing world, it's impossible to save everyone. My strength, my wish, they have no meaning... So what? That's no reason for me to give up--!

1.title: Psychic of Cutting Edge
1.summary: Joining a monster hunt as reserve forces, Alk and the others meet Amou Nagiri, a Japanese swordswoman. Nagiri, a friend of Yae's, asks them to introduce her to strong fighters, and Alk and the others show her to Starview Village, red-faced after Yae spills her secret.

lines.4: Sorry to make you two come all the way out here just as reserve forces...
lines.7: Not at all. Monsters overflowing from the labyrinth's branches concern us too.
lines.10: Well, if anything, are we really okay just standing by like this?
lines.13: Unless something major happens, it'll be fine. Actually, an amazing trainee joined us recently.
lines.25: You're rattled. Please calm down once before you return to the front line.
lines.37: One heart, one blade... Amou Style, here I come!
lines.46: Impressive... That's no mere special ability. That's real swordsmanship.
lines.49: Amazing, right? That's our newcomer, Amou Nagiri. She won't be a trainee for long.
lines.58: Well. We didn't get to do anything at all today.
lines.66: There was an amazing girl. Hey, ending peacefully is a good thing.
lines.70: That's right. Besides, it's because you were standing by that we could give it our all.
lines.76: I apologize for not introducing myself sooner. I'm Amou Nagiri, a Provisional Guild Knight.
lines.79: I've heard a lot about you from my friend... Yae. I'm glad to meet you. Alk, Light, Stella.
lines.83: ...Oh! You're the "super cool friend" Asato mentioned!
lines.87: Sh-she said that about me...? Honestly, Yae...
lines.91: I got Provisional Guild Knight status once too. But you're going to be a full member...?
lines.94: Yes. Once things settle down, I'm set to join the Guild Knights.
lines.97: ...This is a future you all made possible for me.
lines.101: Each day felt like a thousand autumns. I've wanted to thank you for so long. Thank you, truly.
lines.105: ...No, it's... We should be thanking you...
lines.109: If you're ever in trouble, just say the word. We'll help too.
lines.117: In that case, there's one thing I'd like to ask. Only if you're able...
lines.119: Could you introduce me to the strong fighters of Starview Village?
lines.124: So basically... a warrior's training journey?
lines.127: The best way to grow strong is to imitate those who are strong.
lines.129: Ten years honing a single sword... I don't mean to brag, but I was a fairly accomplished swordswoman in Japan. And my ability is like this.
lines.134: A power that creates swords...? That's rather, um, for a young person from Shibuya...
lines.137: I think it's a dangerous power myself. But it also makes sense to me.
lines.140: ...Making this body a blade and polishing it to reach heights I couldn't reach in Japan. As a swordswoman, that's what I want.
lines.143: Besides, in a world like this, strength is necessary, isn't it?
lines.156: Well... I can think of a few people she'd get along with, or at least who'd have the same interests...
lines.162: Nagi-chan, woohoo! Alk finally talked to you! Good for youuu...
lines.169: Wha, Y-Yae...!! Don't say anything unnecessary...!
lines.173: Nagi-chan's a fan of you guys~. Like, "the heroes of Shibuya".
lines.178: If you say one more word, we're through!
lines.181: Th-that's not it! I would never have such frivolous feelings...!
lines.185: I mean, yes, I truly respect all of you for saving Shibuya! But that's admiration!!
lines.190: Yes. Welcome to Starview Village, Nagiri.
lines.195: Anyway, wanna come to Starview Village?
lines.207: I see, so this is Starview Village... What a peaceful, lovely place.
lines.210: You can come anytime, but about this place...
lines.215: A secret of secrets, then. I won't tell even the Guild Knights.
lines.228: Unfortunately, I'm merely a humble ronin. ...You use a sword as well?
lines.233: Y-yes! My name is Amou Nagiri!
lines.235: ...That's not the sword presence of a "humble ronin". What kind of world are you from--

2.title: The Meaning of Strength
2.summary: Having Soushiro look at her swordsmanship, Nagiri goes to Yuki and the others for advice to understand his counsel to "know fear". Through talking about why she started learning the sword, Nagiri comes to understand her "fear", and arrives at her answer: if she wants to do it, she does it. That's all there is to it.

lines.14: Splendid. There's nothing someone like me could tell you. It's a masterful technique.
lines.17: ...Then there's no point in you watching me, is there?
lines.21: The agreement was only to "watch". But I mean it sincerely. A beautiful sword that doesn't seek blood.
lines.24: In a world at peace, this is the kind of sword that's needed, I suppose.
lines.28: My grandfather often told me that precisely because I hold great power, I must train a heart that never turns it against people.
lines.30: ...That true strength lies in mind, technique, and body together. Apparently that's less the school's teaching and more his own view.
lines.32: From where you stand, Soushiro... does my sword carry strength of heart?
lines.36: I see. Then you should come to know fear.
lines.43: Well, that's not for anyone else to say... Oh, we've wandered away from talk of swords.
lines.49: So, that's why I'd like some advice...
lines.52: Hmm, if it's about martial arts, am I really the right person...?
lines.60: Actually, if it's that kind of thing, wouldn't Nimbus or Ayumu be better suited?
lines.65: ...I was raised at an all-girls school. The only men I know are from the dojo and my teachers.
lines.67: So, um, at work or in training it's fine... but one-on-one with a man in private is a little...
lines.73: Ahaha! The gorilla who beat up an Aegis hangout all by herself is acting like a maiden!
lines.78: G-gorilla is rude! Besides, that was because you lot kept forcing people to join...!
lines.85: Never mind what I did...! This is about advice, advice...!
lines.89: Soushiro said fear. Does he mean I don't know true terror, or that there's a fear in my heart I haven't noticed--?
lines.92: This is kind of obvious, but... being scared to fight?
lines.96: ...Is that it? I thought I'd gotten stronger in order to overcome that...
lines.100: Ah, n-no, that's not it, okay? It's not that I learned the sword to defeat bad people, it's more about my state of mind...!
lines.104: It's okay. I get it. ...Like, courage or something?
lines.108: ...Let go of the cliff's edge. I wanted the courage to fight when I had to fight.
lines.111: In elementary school, my only friend was being bullied.
lines.114: ...I don't think I should have grabbed a bamboo sword and beaten them down. But... I...
lines.122: Yes. I never want to look the other way again. That's why I became strong...!
lines.127: Hah, what's that? That's just self-satisfaction. Is there any point~?
lines.137: It's just that I don't want to have regrets... So it's just self-satisfaction--
lines.146: No... Maybe it's not even self-satisfaction?
lines.150: All things change. No matter how strong I get, I can't save everyone.
lines.152: ...And it's not as though that girl, who's no longer here, will forgive me.
lines.154: --I fight so I won't have regrets. But as long as I fight, my regrets keep piling up.
lines.157: So... ah, that's it. This is what Soushiro meant--
lines.160: ...My wish can never come true. Neither having no regrets, nor being forgiven. This path will never reach its destination.
lines.163: My path has no meaning. That's what scares me.
lines.168: Uhh... I don't get it at all... Scary...
lines.172: S-sorry! I kind of convinced myself all on my own...! Um, well...!
lines.176: Hmm... I don't think I really get it either. You're scared it might be meaningless?
lines.183: Even a dragon-slaying skill no one needs is still a skill. If I want to do it, I do it. That's all it ever was...!
lines.186: I see. Then you should do it.
lines.195: That was totally a conversation between two gorillas...
lines.201: Ahaha! Well, duh! There's no way Nagi-chan could ever give up!
lines.205: Yae... Don't make me sound like some spoiled young lady...
lines.212: At least, you've saved me tons of times! Our midterms in middle school, right? Pop quizzes, right? And also...
lines.216: That's your own fault for not doing them properly.
lines.219: Now, now, what I mean is, accept the thanks of the people you've saved!
lines.223: Accept their thanks, hm. That's a fair point.
lines.227: Riiight? Am I a genius or what?

3.title: My Heart Upon the Blade That Carves the Way
3.summary: Visiting Shibuya with Yae for the first time in a while, Nagiri meets Cocoa and the others of Shibuya's underground response team. Heading to the monsters' source to help, Nagiri selfishly saves a boy who was once in Aegis, wipes out the monsters, and goes back to having fun with Yae.

lines.10: Yae, if you shout that loud, you'll bother the people around us.
lines.15: Huh, for real? Was I that loud? So embarrassing!!
lines.19: But, like~, it's been forever since I hung out with you, Nagi-chan! Of course I'm hyped!
lines.23: Well, it's true that Shibuya becoming a "place to come and have fun" is... nostalgic.
lines.28: Nihihi! Riiight! Get hyped too, Nagi-chan! Woohoo!
lines.36: Whoa, so strong~. You're from Shibuya, right?
lines.38: We're the Shibuya Underground Response team! We handle monsters, but a bunch of them got out this time.
lines.41: I'm Amou Nagiri, Provisional Guild Knight. I'll help. Where are the monsters coming from?
lines.43: For real? That's a huge help! A subway station a little ways from here got connected to the labyrinth.
lines.47: Understood. I'll head for the source. Yae, rescue people from the air.
lines.56: Are you all right!? It's dangerous here, please evacuate...!
lines.60: I don't need help...! I've got power!
lines.63: That's reckless! In that state...! Do you want to die!?
lines.67: Anyway, let's get out of here, now!
lines.77: ...It seems the labyrinth branch connected to the subway collapsed, and we fell all the way into the labyrinth.
lines.80: That's the opposite way from the exit. ...If you really want to die, I'll stop you even if I have to hit you.
lines.83: ...I don't want to die. I'm gonna prove I can survive on my own...!
lines.88: I'm getting out of here. If we just happen to be going the same way, that's no problem, is it?
lines.93: I'm just talking to myself here... but I heard there were former Aegis members who refuse to accept protection.
lines.95: And that depending on the situation, the Guild Knights might have to "protect" them by force.
lines.97: Hah, like I'd lose to those small fry. Even Thor had his eye on me.
lines.99: ...Then I'll look forward to crossing blades with you someday.
lines.103: Still a trainee, but yes, more or less.
lines.106: ...People like you are the ones I hate most.
lines.108: Is that so. That has nothing to do with me.
lines.115: ...I'll break their encirclement. Use the opening.
lines.117: Why should I take orders from you?
lines.119: Me, lose to a world like this...! Like hell! Like hell I will!!
lines.121: Just get lost on your own!! I can do this alone...!!
lines.133: If I look the other way here, I'll regret it!
lines.137: This has nothing to do with you. Rather than ignore someone I could save and imagine their resentment--
lines.139: I'd much rather save them and get complained at.
lines.142: If you're getting strong so you can live without anyone's help...
lines.145: Then I'm getting strong so I can help everyone!
lines.150: I don't want to hear that from you! Besides, being strong alone isn't enough to live cut off from everyone--
lines.165: Yae...! Thank you, with this I can!
lines.169: Change of plans. We'll wipe out the monsters right here!
lines.177: Listen! I never asked you to help me!
lines.180: I know. Let's meet again when it's time to "protect" you.
lines.184: I dunno about that. Are you okay with it, Nagi-chan?
lines.188: I don't mind. This is about how I choose to live, and it has nothing to do with him.
lines.190: Well, his principles have nothing to do with me either, so I'll help him again next time.
lines.194: Wow, Nagi-chan, you're seriously brutal sometimes.
lines.197: I decided I'd do it even if it has no meaning.
lines.201: That's so you, Nagi-chan~. Is that too cool or what? I'm gonna fall for you. Actually, I already have. Love you!!
lines.207: Well, the trouble's taken care of, so let's get back to having fun.
lines.211: Ooh, nice~! Then wanna pull an all-nighter in Shibuya?
lines.216: ...Let's see, I found a nice shop in Palpebra--

5000496/1.16: Special Tech Defense Force Shibuya Branch
5000496/1.19:
The Special Tech Defense Force's first otherworld branch, hastily established to help Shibuya.

Its main work is dealing with monsters that appeared in Shibuya after it got crossed with the Kaleidoscope, but for some reason the branch has an oddly relaxed air. Manga hand-picked by Shota Inori and Seiji Takamori, novels recommended by Yuki Mishima, a kotatsu with mandarin oranges, and a full set of video games have turned it into the ideal hangout.

5000635/1.19:
A style of quick-draw swordsmanship handed down for generations in the Amou family, Nagiri's birthplace.
An ancient, practical combat style passed down to the present day, which, combined with Nagiri's natural talent and special ability, has made her an outstanding swordswoman even by Palpebra's standards.
Nagiri's grandfather, who passed the techniques on to her, admonished her: "So that you do not wield great power recklessly, train a strong heart as well."
